description: Ground intelligence for one stay from a finished search: every bar and pub, café, restaurant and grocery within a ten-minute walk (counts, with + when the map read was capped in a dense centre), the nearest stop and the walk to it, and map facts for walking back at night (bars within five minutes, the main road, the walk from the traveller's spot). Facts only: no crime figures, no safety rating. The same block is drawn as a map on the pick's stayUrl. Free; usually instant, a few seconds the first time a stay is asked about. Method: https://stayotter.com/ground.

searchId.description: The searchId from search_stays or get_stay

sourceId.description: The pick's sourceId from the card
